Hi all — adding the SLA details here so Finexa auditors have definitive language.

Summary of Redwood vulnerability SLAs (operational):
- P1 (remote code execution / active exploitation): initial acknowledgement within 1 hour, mitigation plan within 8 hours, remediation or compensating control within 72 hours; automatic escalation to on-call infra lead and customer-facing notice if service impact expected.
- P2 (privilege escalation / critical data exposure): ack within 4 hours, mitigation plan within 24 hours, remediation within 7 days.
- P3 (information disclosure / medium risk): ack within 48 hours, remediation within 30 days as part of scheduled patch window.
- P4 (low / informational): tracked and remediated in quarterly maintenance cycles unless otherwise prioritized.

Notes: we maintain a CVE triage board in Jira (SEC-4721) and use staggered patch windows to avoid customer disruption. For regulated customers we can commit to compressed windows (e.g., P2 -> 72 hours) under enterprise SLAs; please let us know if Finexa needs that uplift.

Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4721

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
